description: Literal text search over indexed file contents — string literals, error messages, env var names, TODO comments, config keys: anything that is not a definition name (use search_symbols for those). Covers non-code files (md/json/yaml/toml/sql/Dockerfile/CI) that no other tool indexes. Word and phrase matching; regex=true for patterns.

cursor.description: continuation token from a truncated response; repeat the same arguments with it

max_tokens.description: soft cap on response size in estimated tokens; truncated output says how to get the rest

path_prefix.description: restrict to files under this root-relative path

query.description: literal text, or a regular expression when regex=true

name: search_content
title: Search file contents
